theme: From Vine to the TikTok feed
editorNotes: Broader audience direction requested. Reference URLs are review destinations; live source requests were blocked in this workspace. Verify sources before approving.

daily.question: Liza Koshy posted on Vine under which name?
daily.explanation: Liza Koshy’s Vine account used the handle Lizzza.

daily.question: “Road work ahead? Uh, yeah, I sure hope it does” is associated with…
daily.explanation: Drew Gooden made the Vine joke responding literally to a “Road Work Ahead” sign.

daily.question: The creator associated with “What are those?” was…
daily.explanation: Brandon Moore, who posted as Young Busco, made the original “What are those?” clip.

daily.question: Addison Rae starred in which 2021 teen-film remake?
daily.explanation: He’s All That is the 2021 remake of She’s All That starring Addison Rae.

daily.question: Bella Poarch’s widely shared 2020 lip-sync used which track?
daily.explanation: Bella Poarch’s 2020 lip-sync used Millie B’s “M to the B.”

daily.question: The original Renegade dance was created by…
daily.explanation: Jalaiah Harmon created the Renegade choreography; its creator credit matters to the story.

daily.question: Remi Bader became known for which recurring fashion-video format?
daily.explanation: Remi Bader’s realistic hauls show how clothing fits and looks on her, including the awkward parts.

daily.question: Which creator started posting as Baddie Winkle?
daily.explanation: Helen Ruth Elam is the creator known online as Baddie Winkle.

daily.question: A TikTok Stitch lets a creator include…
options: A clip from another video before their response
daily.explanation: Stitch incorporates a segment of someone else’s TikTok before a creator adds their own video.

daily.question: A TikTok Duet generally places two videos…
daily.explanation: Duet places a new video alongside the original, usually in a split-screen layout.

tumblr.question: Michelle Phan’s early channel focused on…
tumblr.explanation: Michelle Phan’s early makeup tutorial videos helped establish her beauty audience.

tumblr.question: Bethany Mota competed on which televised dance contest?
options: So You Think You Can Dance
tumblr.explanation: Bethany Mota competed on season 19 of Dancing with the Stars in 2014.

tumblr.question: Michelle Phan’s cosmetics brand is called…
tumblr.explanation: EM Cosmetics is Michelle Phan’s cosmetics brand.

tumblr.question: Tanya Burr’s early YouTube channel centered on…
tumblr.explanation: Tanya Burr’s early YouTube work included beauty tutorials and makeup videos.

tumblr.question: Fleur De Force became known primarily through which YouTube genre?
tumblr.explanation: Fleur De Force built her audience through beauty and lifestyle videos.

youtube.question: Undertale was created by…
youtube.explanation: Toby Fox created Undertale, which was released in 2015.

youtube.question: Which studio developed Among Us?
youtube.explanation: Innersloth developed Among Us, first released in 2018.

youtube.question: Emma Chamberlain began posting to YouTube in which year?
youtube.explanation: Emma Chamberlain began publishing YouTube videos in 2017.

youtube.question: Which YouTuber is known for Lovely World Minecraft videos?
youtube.explanation: Stampy is the creator behind the long-running Lovely World Minecraft series.

youtube.question: Markiplier’s collaborative clothing brand with Jacksepticeye is…
youtube.explanation: Cloak is the clothing brand co-founded by Markiplier and Jacksepticeye in 2018.

modern.question: Bella Poarch’s debut single was…
modern.explanation: Bella Poarch released her debut single Build a Bitch in 2021.

modern.question: Which Carlson sister is older?
modern.explanation: Devon Lee Carlson is the older Carlson sister; Sydney is younger.

modern.question: LaurDIY’s first name is…
modern.explanation: Lauren Riihimaki is known online as LaurDIY.

modern.question: Enya Umanzor’s co-host Drew has which surname?
modern.explanation: Drew Phillips is Enya Umanzor’s Emergency Intercom co-host.

modern.question: Trixie Mattel’s makeup brand is…
modern.explanation: Trixie Mattel’s cosmetics brand is Trixie Cosmetics.

clues: A short-video platform whose jokes kept traveling after the app was gone.
Its clips replayed in a loop.
A lot of later YouTube and TikTok creators built audiences there.
Six seconds was the original video length.
Its name is also a climbing plant.
